_doc: Known structural-failure baseline for the ASHRAE 140 strict +/-15% annual-energy gate (issue #2506, extended in issue #3572 to cover the eight cases 600/800/810/900/920/950/960/970). The Case 600/900 annual COOLING physics gap is NOT yet fixed (tracked by the post-#1323 / #1213 / #1328 cooling-load chain); these two metrics are expected to FAIL the +/-15% band today. The strict-energy-gate workflow runs the eight `#[ignore]`'d strict tests with `--include-ignored`, parses the printed H/C values, computes each metric's gap as a percentage of the band midpoint, and compares against this baseline. The gate FAILS only when a metric REGRESSES beyond `regression_tolerance_pp` percentage points worse than its recorded `gap_pct_of_mid` (or when a previously-`pass` metric starts failing beyond the tolerance). When the physics is fixed and a cooling metric re-enters its band (gap == 0), lower its value here and eventually un-ignore the tests (issues #1333 / #2506 / #3572 acceptance). Do NOT raise a baseline gap to make a regression disappear (RULES.md: no parameter tuning). Updated 2026-09-29 by PR #4265 (Issue #4156): unified HVAC coefficient. Refreshed 2026-09-30 by the PR #4265 follow-up to also reflect the Case 900 H, Case 960 H, and the 13 other per-case measurements not covered by the original PR. The original PR's `value_mwh=3.144, gap_pct_of_mid=65.36` for Case 900 H was internally inconsistent (the gap did not correspond to the value under the standard band_pct_of_mid formula) and has been corrected to the measured 3.723/116.95 pair. Re-recorded 2026-10-12 (loop round 18, issue #4168, PR branch): the Case 800/810 published_range_mwh entries are now the transcribed ASHRAE 140-2023 Annex B8 §B8.1 inter-program envelope (Std140_TF_Results.pdf Tables B8-1..B8-4, pp. 8-11), replacing the synthetic-fitted ranges; engine values 7.039/3.591/1.680/1.684 re-measured unchanged on the round-18 branch (deterministic, byte-identical to the prior capture); gaps recomputed against the new band midpoints. Statuses remain known_fail — no gap was raised or lowered to hide anything; the 810 cooling gap FELL (46.73 -> 1.10) purely because the synthetic band it was measured against was itself unfit.

Per RULES.md ("never raise baselines to hide regressions") we mark the current measured gap as `known_fail` rather than claiming pass; DONE 2026-10-12 (loop round 19): §LIMIT-25 / §LIMIT-26 entries were added to docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md, co-locating the structural rationale with this failure record. Cases 920 / 950 / 960 / 970 each have a documented LIMIT entry (920 -> §LIMIT-05 UPDATE #2453 cohort, 950 -> -> §LIMIT-17 / §LIMIT-24, 960 -> §LIMIT-14, 970 -> §LIMIT-23).
_rule: Per AGENTS.md / RULES.md: this file records the KNOWN gap; it must never be loosened to hide a regression. Only lower a gap when the engine genuinely improved, and commit the improving change together with the baseline update.

_tolerance_fraction_doc: Band edges = midpoint(published_range) * (1 +/- tolerance_fraction). Matches ANNUAL_TOLERANCE_PCT in tests/zone_balance_eplus_isolation.rs.
_regression_tolerance_pp_doc: A metric may get at most this many percentage-points worse (relative to band midpoint) than its recorded gap_pct_of_mid before the gate fails for regression. Absorbs cross-runner numerical noise; tuned for deterministic release builds. A previously-passing metric (gap 0) that drifts outside the band by more than this tolerance ALSO trips the gate.
